description: This file defines the IJSONStateDataManager interface, which provides methods for reading, writing, and deleting JSON-based state data in storage providers within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: IJSONStateDataManager
classes.description: Interface for managing JSON state data in storage providers, including methods for delete, read, and write operations.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the grain state associated with a given key from the collection.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads grain state from storage and returns JSON data or null if not found.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes the provided JSON string as grain state into storage.

calls: System.Threading.Tasks.Task Write(string collectionName, string key, string entityData)
